y = a\left(x^2 - \frac{1}{2}x + \frac{1}{16}\right) - \frac{9}{8} = ax^2 - \frac{a}{2}x + \frac{a}{16} - \frac{9}{8}

\]

\[
a + \left(-\frac{a}{2}\right) + \left(\frac{a}{16} - \frac{9}{8}\right) = a - \frac{a}{2} + \frac{a}{16} - \frac{9}{8}
\]

\[

\]

\[
\frac{9}{16}a - \frac{9}{8}
\]

\[
\frac{9}{16}a - \frac{9}{8} = k
\]
